title: DevOps Roadmap
description: Frontmatter schema for a single roadmap file under roadmaps/<slug>.md. A roadmap is an ordered sequence of stages answering 'what should I learn, and in what order' for a target role — distinct from a Guide (deep reference) and a Question (practice). Stage prose (description, why_it_matters, learning_objectives, completion_criteria) lives in the markdown body under '## Stage: <title>' headings, not in frontmatter; only machine-readable stage data lives here. categories values must also exist in schemas/taxonomy.json.

id.description: Globally unique identifier, kebab-case. Roadmaps are few and curated, so unlike question ids this has no numeric sequence suffix.

title.description: Roadmap title, used as the page H1 and the default meta title.

description.description: One to two sentences summarizing the roadmap's scope and audience. Feeds the meta description.

target_role.description: The canonical Interview Level this roadmap targets — reuses the same 8-value enum as guide.schema.json's interview_levels rather than introducing a separate role taxonomy.

id.description: Stable, kebab-case identifier for this stage, unique within the roadmap (e.g. "foundations").

title.description: Stage display name. Must exactly match the '## Stage: <title>' heading in the markdown body that holds this stage's prose.

prerequisites.description: Ids of stages within this same roadmap that should come first. Validated for existence and acyclicity.

categories.description: taxonomy.json category slugs this stage draws its dynamic question pool from.

related_guides.description: Ids of existing guides this stage points to for deep reference. Validated for existence.

recommended_questions.description: A small, manually curated checkpoint set of question ids (kept intentionally small — 2 to 4). The broader representative practice set is derived dynamically at render time from `categories`, the same way a Guide's Practice Questions section works.
